body.text: You will wish to know — though you did not ask, and I did not wait — that the matter you wrote of is settled.
I acted on my own judgement. I am confident you would have arrived at the same place, given a month or two.
You are of course free to countermand me. The thing is done, but you are free to do it.
I did not think it could wait on the tide, and I hope you will not think me forward.
